answer: Operator-Liability Quill Penalty. Each agent action must cite an operator-signed quill token; identical tokens across many wallets reveal a shared operator and trigger a thread linking those wallets into one liability group. On the first violation, the group's off-chain deposit is slashed and the operator is pushed past a hard ledge: all its wallets lose write access until it posts a per-wallet reserve equal to the median action fee times the group size. An attacker pays roughly the full clone population's fee in reserve, refunded only if no further duplicate-quill events occur.
